page.content:
Chef's-choice sequence, the tasting form of a serious sushi counter.

How Omakase connects

  • Topic: Itamae — Omakase leaves the sequence of nigiri to the itamae.
  • Character: Jiro Ono — Jiro's shop is known worldwide as a strict omakase nigiri sequence.
  • Item: Gari — Gari resets the palate between pieces in a sushi sequence.

What is Omakase?

Omakase — 'I leave it to you' — is how Edomae shops pace nigiri: the itamae chooses order, temperature, and neta rather than a à-la-carte checklist.

Key threads lead to Itamae, Jiro Ono and Gari.
